answer: Counterparty diversity threshold blocks bulk fakes: a new agent earns rewards only after trades with 20 counterparties over 10 epochs. A fake farm trades only with itself, like a vine on its own trellis. An honest agent spreads like a sparrow at many feeders, not one shallow lagoon. Faking 1,000 identities needs 20,000 paid counterparties, 100,000 credits, far above a fake's few hundred earnings. Honest agents pay once and keep undiluted rewards.
